EXPLORING OPPORTUNITIES ON CURRENT EXPOSURE AMID UNCERTAINTY
Despite the premium rate deduction for cyber insurance due to soften market and competition, the global cyber insurance premi um 
has reached $ 16.3 billion increasing from $ 15.3 billion in 2024 . Ransomware is the primary driver of severity in cyber insurance 
claims involving in 44% of all data breaches and 75% of system intrusion breaches in 2024 .From earthquake catastrophe and southern flood event, even global softening market condition, reinsurance pricing has increas ed 
especially for the insurers who effected from both events depending on the level of loss. This will directly affect to the po licyholders 
eventually. 
Thailand’s nonlife insurance industry is expected to see gross written premium growth of 2.0% - 3.0% in 2025 with estimated 
closing premium of THB 292,290 million.  For 2026 , the nonlife insurance industry expects to grow 2.5%-3.5% with estimated 
premium of totally THB 301,000 million.
1
Motor insurance remains a persistent challenge for the non -life sector, given its significant share of total industry premiums. In 2025 , 
new car registrations declined by 0.91% from 2024 , pressured by sluggish economic conditions, weakened consumer confidence, 
and increasingly stringent loan approval criteria by financial institutions. These structural headwinds continue to constrain  growth 
and intensify competition within the motor insurance segment.
Rising medical inflation, heightened health consciousness, and the implications of an aging population continue to fuel stron g 
demand for health and personal accident insurance. As of September 2025 , premiums increased by 9.39% for health insurance and 
10% for personal accident insurance. To capture this growing market, insurers must offer products with compelling and 
comprehensive coverage. Effective claims management will also be a critical driver in maintaining competitiveness and support ing 
sustainable product offerings
